visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brown and white Shiba Inu sits alertly on a tan tiled floor in a bright indoor hallway. The dog faces the camera directly with its mouth closed. In the top-left corner, a yellow logo with a paw print and the text '柴犬Nana & 阿楞的一天!' is visible. The background is a clean white wall and a doorway to another room. (2) The dog begins to vocalize, opening its mouth to perform a series of barks. Its head tilts slightly as it responds to off-camera cues. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear at the bottom center of the frame. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the dog's fur. (3) A human hand enters from the left edge of the frame, holding a small brown piece of meat. The dog reaches forward and takes the food gently with its mouth. The scene cuts slightly closer to the dog's face as it chews the treat. (4) The dog continues to follow commands, performing a 'mute' bark where it opens its mouth wide without making a sound. It then licks its lips. (5) The human hand reappears to pet the dog's head and neck as a reward. The dog squints its eyes and appears relaxed while being petted. A social media watermark '@nana_aleng' is seen in the bottom-right corner.
